title: Contractor Visit Fees and Included Tune-Ups, Home Protection Plans
content:
Under every Home Protection Plan, the customer pays a service fee to the network contractor for each covered repair visit. The fee, the repeat-visit waiver period and the included preventive tune-ups are set per plan below.

## Visit fee schedule

| Plan | Service fee per covered repair visit (USD, paid by the customer to the contractor) | Repeat-visit fee waiver period (calendar days after a covered repair) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | 0.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | 0.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | 0.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | 0.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | 50.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | 75.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | 75.00 | 30 |

The repeat-visit waiver period is the number of calendar days after a covered repair during which a return visit for the same failure carries no service fee.

## Included preventive tune-ups

| Plan | Preventive tune-up included | Included tune-ups per plan year | Service fee waived on an included tune-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | No | 0 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | No | 0 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | No | 0 | No |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | No | 0 | No |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | Yes | 2 | Yes |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | Yes | 2 | Yes |

## Notes

- Four plans carry a service fee of 0.00, so a covered repair visit under Beacon Ridge Surge Shield, Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard, Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard or Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care costs the customer no visit fee.
- Included tune-ups are counted per plan year: 1 under Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan and 2 under Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete and Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield.
